description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for Git's attribute checking functionality, including functions to verify attribute values, handling of paths and patterns, source attribute logic, and various edge cases like large attribute lines and symlink handling.

methods.name: attr_check_basic
methods.description: Checks basic git attribute for a given path, expected value, and options.

methods.name: attr_check
methods.description: Runs basic check and ensures no error output.

methods.name: attr_check_object_mode_basic
methods.description: Checks the object mode attribute for a given path.

methods.name: attr_check_object_mode
methods.description: Runs object mode check and ensures no error output.

methods.name: attr_check_quote
methods.description: Checks attribute with a quoted path.

methods.name: attr_check_source
methods.description: Checks attributes considering source, multiple source options, and environment variable.
